_comment: SAMPLE DATA — the decision log. status: decided | pending. Pending decisions surface on the Overview so nothing stalls silently. issueNumber links to the GitHub Issue thread where the decision is discussed. Pending decisions should carry `neededBy` (YYYY-MM-DD) — the dashboard shows waiting time vs deadline and flags overdue decisions.

decisions.title: WiSE messaging house v1 locked
decisions.decision: Adopt the 'confident simplicity' messaging house as the single source for all launch assets. Revisit post-launch with win/loss data.

decisions.title: Hub is the single reporting source for the pilot
decisions.decision: During the pilot, all four members stop maintaining separate status decks; exec updates are generated from the hub.
